reasoning: Shows a half-filled Wi-Fi signal wedge with a padlock badge, universally understood as secured or password-protected Wi-Fi. While originating as a system status indicator for signal strength, it serves well as a specific icon for tasks about Wi-Fi passwords, guest networks, and router security, though it is easily confused with other Wi-Fi strength variants.

pass1.ambiguity: It depicts a specific OS status bar state (medium signal strength, password-protected) rather than just a generic Wi-Fi icon, which looks nearly identical to full/low signal variants at small sizes.
